Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2, alerting oncall (threshold 1.5s, current p99 2.8s). Auto-pager triggered. Thread created 4210001234
Amelia (SRE): acked - joining. seeing spike in tail latency on streaming paths?
Jack (Telemetry): confirmed. Grafana panel shows p95 ~700ms, p99 ~2.8s, error rate stable. spike started ~4210001100, correlates with increased streaming connections to model-x-quant. Link: https://grafana.redwood/in/dash/latency?from=4210001000&to=4210001299
Raj (Eng): @Amelia any recent rollouts for model variants or kv-cache changes in us-west-2?
Amelia (SRE): No deployment, but there was a rollout of a new batching policy yesterday. Could be workload shift causing tail stalls.
Priya (Support): We're getting 6 reports from customers about slow responses on chat sessions in the west region, notes say responses hang then finish. No 500s.
SRE Lead: Triage steps: 1) verify streaming stall vs compute queueing 2) check KV cache hit rate 3) decide mitigation: rollback batching policy OR enable degraded steady-mode (non-streaming) for affected routes
Jack (Telemetry): KV cache hit rate dropped from 87% -> 41% around 4210001050. Also see per-instance CPU spiking on some hosts (gpu1-*-west). Logs: ```
[4210001052] host=gpu1-13 queue_len=42 stall_ms=2300 model=model-x-quant seq_len=512
[4210001060] host=gpu1-13 kv_cache_miss=1.0
```
Amelia (SRE): sounds like cache churn + long sequences causing KV eviction thrashing -> tail stalls. Quick mitigation: route streaming traffic away from overloaded hosts and enable prefix caching fallback.
Raj (Eng): I can flip routing policy to avoid pool-13 and add an emergency scale-up on dedicated pool. Command I will run: ```sh
# move traffic off pool-13
redwood route update --pool us-west-2-pool-13 --drain --timeout 300s
# scale dedicated pool
redwood capacity scale --pool us-west-2-dedicated --gpus +2
```
Amelia (SRE): while Raj runs that, enable degraded-mode for streaming routes to drop streaming coalescing and favor non-stream incremental responses: ```json
{"streaming_mode":"disabled","fallback_model":"model-x-8bit"}
```
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-INC-8421, severity=SEV-2. Paging rotation: Amelia -> SRE Lead.
SRE Lead: @Raj go ahead with drain and scale. @Amelia monitor p99 and KV hit rate. Priya, ask CS to collect customer IDs and timestamps for the reports.
Priya (Support): Collected 6 session ids and timestamps, sending to #support-escalations and pasted into the incident doc. Customers impacted appear to be mid-sized chat workloads with long contexts.
Jack (Telemetry): After routing change started at 4210001180, p99 dropped to 1.7s then 1.2s after scale completed at 4210001220. KV hit rate recovered to 78% by 4210001240.
Amelia (SRE): good improvement. Still seeing occasional 2s spikes for sequences >1024. Likely need a longer-term fix: tune KV cache size or LRU window for long contexts.
Raj (Eng): I'll revert the new batching policy for the affected service and open a follow-up PR to add a grace-period for KV cache warming. Command to rollback: ```sh
redwood rollout revert --service inference-batcher --to-revision r2024-07-19
```
SRE Lead: Do the rollback during low traffic window if possible; if the policy causes instability now, prioritize safety and roll back immediately.
Amelia (SRE): rollback initiated 4210001250. Monitoring.
Oncall Bot: Automatic update: rollback job started by Raj at 4210001250.
Jack (Telemetry): After rollback complete 4210001275, p99 stabilized at 800-950ms; tail spikes rare. Marking metrics as degraded->stabilizing.
Priya (Support): Sent customer updates stating we've mitigated and investigating root cause; will follow up with timeline.
SRE Lead: Post-incident actions: - Run KV cache sizing experiment - Add alert for KV hit-rate drop >20% correlated with p99 spike - Harden routing to more gracefully handle host draining - Add runbook step for immediate degraded-mode toggle
Amelia (SRE): adding notes to incident doc and creating follow-up tickets. Thanks team, will handoff to morning oncall for RCA depth.
Oncall Bot: Incident closed to active paging at 4210001299 (status: mitigated).
